0.text: Well, don’t just stand there, say something. Another shell-shocked villager are you? Gee, what’ve they told you about me? That I’m a witch?

1.text: Well, that part is true… That I eat small children? Boil babies? Ha! I can tell by the look on your face, the stories are still going strong. Well, I hate to disappoint you, but I am for the most part just an old woman dreaming of her youth.

2.text: Ahem, I mean… “Behold, and cower before the mighty Witch of Mulbirth!" Although you can call me Tinnethara, or Tinny for short. Ha Ha Ha.

3.text: I suppose you’ll be wanting to hear about all the spells  I can perform? Why else would you be here? You must be of the inquisitive type. But shall I show you my powers?

0.text: I came to learn.

1.text: First things first however... I’ll need you to help me out before I show you anything. Gather for me some ingredients for my witch’s brew: Four Queens Ear and three Reedflutes should do it.

2.text: We’ll also need a bag of sunflower seeds, but they are hard to come by. I will give you the bag of seeds when you return, much too valuable to give to just anyone..

3.text: Got that? Well, tick tock! Skedaddle already!

1.text: So here, take the recipe, brew it at home, in secret and bring it back to me. Don’t think I won't notice if you skimp out on those sunflower seeds either, they’re what gives it an extra kick!

2.text: Stupid oaf must’ve felt spurned because he was one of the first to cast the vote to exile me from the village way back then during them Dandelion Wars.

1.text: Now, let’s teach you a spell or two? Are you certain you want to learn? If anyone ever sees you practicing magic in public, you’ll wind up just like me, or worse!

0.text: I'm sure

Very well then. Let's begin. Walk over to the <c=lore>Runic pillars</c> on the far side of the cave and trace the Runes to your journal. <c=ooc>Press the journal page to the stone near the Rune to create a rubbing.</c>

1.text: <c=ooc>Only Runic pillars with the yellow sparkle effects will be copied into your journal, teleport pillars are not copied to the journal</c>

2.text: <c=ooc>To cast a spell, use the Trigger button to trace the outline of the Rune, then press the Trackpad (A/X on Rift) to submit the spell</c>

3.text: <c=ooc>Pay close attention to line intersections as variations can cause a failure.</c>

1.text: Practicing your Runespeak is an honorable thing, but utter the language in front of the wrong person and you’ll find yourself sleeping in the darkest dungeon of the Order’s jails.
